title: Resolution of System Truncation & Bridge Wiring Fix
summary: Identified and resolved gaps in the MCP Bridge transport and missing deployment artifacts.
key_findings: MCP Bridge was omitting the deploymentConfig payload in integrate_mcp_tool calls.
apps/api/Dockerfile was missing, causing a break in the Phase 4 CI/CD chain.
pnpm-workspace.yaml was missing from the Docker build context.
conclusions: System integrity restored. Pinnacle loop now supports full deployment context.
recommendations: Execute p0-s6-smoke-test.sh to verify bridge wiring.
